info.title: Yijie Events
info.description: Event contracts exchanged by Yijie services.

agentSessionEvents.description: Sanitized Agent Host events. Consumers order and resume events by stream_id plus sequence and deduplicate at-least-once delivery by event_id.

agentSessionEventsV2.description: Explicitly negotiated v2 Agent Host events. This stream preserves v1 lifecycle events and adds bounded raw-reasoning text delta/finalized variants.

agentSessionEventsV3.description: Explicitly negotiated v3 Agent Host events. This stream preserves v2 lifecycle and reasoning events and adds the closed structured-artifact lifecycle. Only the exact-local synthetic producer is authorized by this candidate; real provider/tool production remains closed.

agentSessionEventsV4.description: Explicitly negotiated v4 Agent Host events. This stream preserves every v3 variant and adds AgentMessage phase metadata plus authoritative stable plan snapshots. Body text is never a durable telemetry surface.

agentSessionEventsV5.description: Explicitly negotiated v5 Agent Host events. This stream keeps the named v4 event families, closes generic Item kinds to a stable allowlist, and adds bounded Command lifecycle/output and generic MCP Tool lifecycle/progress projections. V1-v4 remain unchanged. It does not add approval, FileChange, Diff, experimental, or unknown generic Item capabilities.

receiveAgentSessionEvents.description: Receive one AgentSessionEvent at a time. A stream_id change starts a new ordering domain; it does not imply replay of events from an earlier Host process.

receiveAgentSessionEventsV2.description: Receive one AgentSessionEventV2 at a time after explicit schema-version-2 negotiation. A stream_id change starts a new ordering domain. Delivery is at least once and consumers deduplicate by event_id.

receiveAgentSessionEventsV3.description: Receive one AgentSessionEventV3 after explicit schema-version-3 negotiation. A stream_id change starts a new ordering domain. Delivery is at least once and consumers deduplicate by event_id.

receiveAgentSessionEventsV4.description: Receive one AgentSessionEventV4 after explicit schema-version-4 negotiation. A plan event is one complete authoritative snapshot; a stream_id change starts a new ordering domain. Delivery is at least once and consumers deduplicate by event_id.

receiveAgentSessionEventsV5.description: Receive one AgentSessionEventV5 after explicit schema-version-5 negotiation. A stream_id change starts a new ordering domain. Delivery is at least once, consumers deduplicate only by event_id, and equal output text carried by distinct events remains distinct.

AgentSessionEvent.title: Ordered Agent Host session event
AgentSessionEvent.summary: At-least-once event ordered by sequence within a single stream_id.
AgentSessionEvent.description: JSON payload semantics are authoritative in the referenced JSON Schema. Protobuf message yijie.events.v1.AgentSessionEvent carries the equivalent service and asynchronous-consumer model.

correlationId.description: Agent Host session that owns the ordered event stream.

AgentSessionEventV2.description: JSON payload semantics are authoritative in the referenced JSON Schema. Protobuf message yijie.events.v2.AgentSessionEvent carries the equivalent service and asynchronous-consumer model. Producers emit v2 only after the consumer explicitly negotiates schema version 2.

correlationId.description: Agent Host session that owns the ordered event stream.

AgentSessionEventV4.summary: V3 events plus AgentMessage phase and stable plan snapshots.
AgentSessionEventV4.description: JSON payload semantics are authoritative in the referenced JSON Schema. Protobuf message yijie.events.v4.AgentSessionEvent carries the equivalent service and asynchronous-consumer model. Producers emit v4 only after the consumer explicitly negotiates schema version 4.

AgentSessionEventV5.name: AgentSessionEventV5
AgentSessionEventV5.title: Ordered Agent Host session event v5
AgentSessionEventV5.summary: Named v4 event families plus safe Command output and generic MCP Tool progress.
AgentSessionEventV5.description: JSON payload semantics are authoritative in the referenced JSON Schema. Protobuf message yijie.events.v5.AgentSessionEvent is a typed transport projection, not an independent validity authority. Protobuf adapters must reject every message that would fail the referenced JSON Schema before apply or persistence. Producers emit v5 only after the consumer explicitly negotiates schema version 5. The pinned Runtime schema defines MCP Tool in-progress, completed, and failed states; this contract does not assert a registered product Tool producer, and consumers must not infer a declined producer status.

correlationId.description: Agent Host session that owns the ordered event stream.

session-event.schema.title: AgentSessionEvent
session-event.schema.description: A sanitized Agent Host event. The event_type discriminator selects one payload, correlation-ID, and terminal-state variant. Sequence is monotonic only within one stream_id. A new Host process creates a new stream_id and does not replay content from an earlier process.

session-event-v2.schema.title: AgentSessionEventV2
session-event-v2.schema.description: A sanitized Agent Host event negotiated through the v2 stream. It preserves v1 lifecycle semantics and adds bounded raw-reasoning text projection. Sequence is monotonic only within one stream_id and delivery is at least once.

session-event-v3.schema.title: AgentSessionEventV3
session-event-v3.schema.description: Explicitly negotiated v3 Agent Host event. It preserves v2 lifecycle and reasoning semantics and adds sanitized structured-artifact lifecycle events. Ordering is monotonic only within stream_id and delivery is at least once.

session-event-v4.schema.title: AgentSessionEventV4
session-event-v4.schema.description: Explicitly negotiated v4 Agent Host event. It preserves every v3 lifecycle, reasoning, and structured-artifact variant, adds authoritative AgentMessage phase on lifecycle events, and adds stable turn.plan.updated snapshots. Ordering is monotonic only within stream_id and delivery is at least once.

session-event-v5.schema.title: AgentSessionEventV5
session-event-v5.schema.description: Explicitly negotiated v5 Agent Host event. It keeps the named v4 event families, closes generic Item kinds to a stable allowlist, and adds bounded Command and Tool projections. Ordering is monotonic only within stream_id and delivery is at least once.
